translation:
Do you think Nagato's got a strong sixth
sense?

I heard from Kyon that you said something
along those lines.

To tell you the truth, I'm not sure why, but
something does give me that impression.

Doesn't it seem like she has some kind of
mysterious power that others don't?

I-I wonder… I think she's quite normal
though…
That's wrong, Mikuru.

She joined the SOS Brigade, so there
absolutely must be something special about her.
I definitely hope there is!
U-ummm…

Mikuru—are you interested in sensing the
supernatural?
N-no! I'm not interested!

Ah… Mikuru, there's a dimly glowing hand on
your shoulder…
[#SK0Eeeeekkkkkk]?!

Nah, it's just a joke! A joke! You're so cute
after all, Mikuru~
P-please don't scare me like that!

If this were Yuki, she'd have no reaction at all
for sure.

Did you know? Spirits and ghosts are weak
against people who aren't afraid of them.
I-is that true…?

It seems like if someone is brave enough, or
has a lot of guts, they just get left alone.
But you're always afraid, aren't you~
Errr, is that so…

And that's why even though it's not related
to sensing the supernatural, I'll count on that.

When the time comes, you won't be able to
enjoy unnatural phenomena if you're spineless.
I-I don't think you have to enjoy it.

That won't do. As an SOS Brigade member you
always have to stay cool in the heat of it.
That's definitely impossible…

Next time, let's do special training in a
haunted house or something!
Ehhhh?! S-special training?!

Yup. It's a great idea, if I do say so myself.
That slacker Kyon can come with us as well!
S-surely not…?!

[#P06I]'ve bought us some time, but… I'm not sure
how I feel about this, Kyon.
